India Women's Cricket Captain Refuses Handshake with Pakistan Counterpart

During the toss for an Asia Cup match between the Indian and Pakistani women's cricket teams on Saturday, Indian captain Harmanpreet Kaur did not shake hands with Pakistani captain Fatima Sana. Kaur maintained this stance, which had been in place for the match. The specific actions of Sana after Kaur's refusal were not detailed in the coverage.
